The Science
What is Emsculpt NEO?

Emsculpt NEO is a revolutionary non-invasive body sculpting treatment that simultaneously builds muscle and reduces fat. It combines two powerful technologies â High-Intensity Focused Electromagnetic (HIFEM+) energy and Radiofrequency (RF) heating â in a single 30-minute session.

One session of Emsculpt NEO induces 20,000 supramaximal muscle contractions â equivalent to performing 20,000 crunches or squats â while RF energy heats and destroys fat cells beneath the skin.

The HIFEM+ technology forces muscles into intense contractions that are impossible to achieve through voluntary exercise. The muscle tissue adapts by remodeling its internal structure, resulting in muscle growth and fat burning simultaneously. The RF component raises the temperature of fat cells, causing them to undergo apoptosis (permanent cell death) and be naturally eliminated by the body.

Dual Technology
How Does It Work?

HIFEM+ Technology

High-Intensity Focused Electromagnetic energy triggers supramaximal contractions â far beyond what voluntary exercise can achieve. This forces rapid muscle fiber remodeling and growth, while simultaneously releasing fatty acids that destroy fat deposits.

Radiofrequency Heating

RF energy raises the temperature of fat cells to 43â45Â°C, causing irreversible thermal damage (apoptosis). Damaged fat cells are naturally eliminated by the body over the following weeks, resulting in permanent fat layer reduction.

Your Journey
Treatment Protocol

A typical Emsculpt NEO protocol involves 4 sessions scheduled over 2 weeks, with each session lasting just 30 minutes.

Session 1 â Introduction

Your body gets introduced to HIFEM+ and RF. Intensity is gradually increased to a comfortable level. You'll feel strong muscle contractions and gentle warmth. Many clients describe the sensation as an intense but tolerable workout.

Session 2 â Building Momentum

Intensity is increased based on your comfort. Muscle contractions become deeper and more effective. Fat cells continue to heat and break down. You may already notice improved muscle firmness.

Session 3 â Peak Performance

Optimal treatment intensity achieved. Maximum supramaximal contractions for muscle remodeling. Cumulative fat cell destruction accelerates visible changes. Clothes may already fit differently.

Session 4 â The Finale

Final treatment session to maximize results. Body composition changes are well underway. Results will continue developing over the next 2â3 months as the body naturally eliminates damaged fat cells and muscles continue to strengthen.

Session Details
Duration: 30 minutes per session
Frequency: 2â3 days apart
Total Protocol: 4 sessions over 2 weeks
Maintenance: Optional sessions every 3â6 months

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Is Emsculpt NEO painful?

Most clients describe the experience as intense but comfortable. You'll feel strong muscle contractions and gentle warmth from the RF energy. No anesthesia is required. Many clients actually enjoy the sensation and find it strangely addictive after the first session.

How soon will I see results?

Some patients feel improvements immediately after the first session â increased muscle firmness and toning. Visible fat reduction typically appears 2â4 weeks after completing all 4 sessions, with optimal results at 2â3 months as fat cells are naturally eliminated.

Are the results permanent?

Fat cells destroyed by Emsculpt NEO are permanently eliminated. However, maintaining results requires a healthy lifestyle. Muscle gains can be sustained with occasional maintenance sessions every 3â6 months.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Emsculpt NEO pairs excellently with treatments like CoolSculpting, Exilis Elite, and lymphatic drainage. Our experts at ISAAC Luxe can design a comprehensive body contouring plan tailored to your goals.

How many sessions do I need?

The standard protocol is 4 sessions over approximately 2 weeks, spaced 2â3 days apart. Some patients opt for additional sessions for enhanced results. Maintenance sessions every 3â6 months are recommended.

Is there any downtime?

Absolutely none. You can walk in during your lunch break and return to work immediately. There's no recovery period, no restrictions on activities, and no special aftercare needed.
